text:
lee.sales: Heads-up - Apollo Financial wants an assurance bundle for their procurement upload before the exec review. They asked for SOC2 excerpt, ISO certificate page, pen-test attestation, and whether we permit credentialed scans during the POC.
sam.se: We can provide a SOC 2 Type II cover/excerpt and ISO 27001 certificate page + scope statement. Pen-test: signed attestation + 1-page executive summary only. No raw reports.
nina.security: Credentialed scans are allowed only on dedicated or isolated staging endpoints with an approved test plan, source IP allowlist, supervised window, and signed NDA addendum. No destructive testing or persistent test accounts.
lee.sales: They prefer SFTP upload into their procurement portal. Can ops provide that or a presigned link?
maria.ops: I can provision a presigned S3 link or an SFTP dropbox; need recipient emails and the legal entity name for the attestation.
sam.se: Pricing note: standard enterprise POC includes the basic evidence pack. Supervised credentialed scans, legal redaction, or extended review are billable via SOW. Indicative small SOWs start around $5k.
lee.sales: Please give me a one-paragraph statement and a tiny checklist I can paste into their portal.
nina.security: One-paragraph: "We will provide a SOC 2 Type II excerpt, ISO 27001 certificate page and scope statement, and a signed pen-test attestation with an executive summary. We do not provide raw vulnerability scan outputs or internal audit working papers. Credentialed (authenticated) scans during the POC are permitted only on dedicated/staging endpoints with an approved test plan, source IP allowlist, supervised testing window, and a signed NDA addendum; supervised test support is billable via SOW."
nina.security: Checklist (copy/paste):
```
- SOC 2 Type II: cover/excerpt PDF (no audit working papers)
- ISO 27001: certificate page + scope statement
- Pen-test attestation: signed letter + 1-page exec summary (no raw reports)
- KMS & encryption controls one-pager
- High-level network diagram (redacted; no hostnames/IPs)
- Pre-scan requirements: test plan, source IPs, test window, scope (staging/dedicated), signed NDA addendum
- Delivery: presigned S3 link or SFTP (time-limited)
- Contact for SOW/ supervised-test quote
```
maria.ops: I will provision the presigned S3 bundle once I have recipient emails. evidence-bot: Ticket created: EVID-9504 for Apollo Financial evidence request.
lee.sales: Thanks all
